entities.summary: Lithai, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Sukhothai Kingdom (1298–1438). Preceded by Sukhothai Decline and Absorption and Ayutthaya Empire. Their legacy influenced King Ramathibodi I founds Ayutthaya.
